## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior.

## Reproduction

Include the smallest code, input values, and operation sequence that reproduce
the problem. Include grid configuration, topology, storage kind, world/grid
lifetimes, query bounds, and operation order when relevant. Include raw Q32.32
values when rounding matters. Remove private data.

For nondeterministic results, include both outputs and the inputs used by each
runtime.
